blocks.text: Woodburn is a surname. Notable people with the surname include:

items: Alex Woodburn, English rugby union player
Arthur Woodburn (1890–1978), Scottish politician; MP, government minister, and Secretary of State for Scotland
Kim Woodburn (1942–2025), English television personality and expert cleaner
William Woodburn (1838–1915), American politician from Nevada; U.S. representative 1875–89

blocks.text: Woodburn is a small town on the banks of the Richmond River in New South Wales, Australia. Woodburn is 712 km north of Sydney, and 34 km south of Lismore. Until the town was bypassed in September 2020, the Pacific Highway passed through the centre of town.
